# @adexdsamson/forge

> Forge is a cross-platform React form library that wraps react-hook-form with a composable API. Call `useForge()` to get the full RHF toolkit plus an augmented `control`, render `<Forge control={...}>` as the form container, and drop `<Forger>` field wrappers around any custom input — web or React Native. Platform detection is automatic: web renders a real `<form>`, React Native renders a Fragment.

## Docs

- [README](ReadMe.md): Quickstart guide with web and React Native examples.
- [API Reference](docs/API.md): Full prop and return-value tables for every exported symbol.
- [Agent Usage Guide](AGENTS.md): Recipes, common mistakes, and LLM-optimised usage patterns.
- [CHANGELOG](CHANGELOG.md): Version history.

## Examples

- [React Native Example](examples/ReactNativeExample.md): Complete runnable RN form with multiple field types, validation, and submission.
